cd "$(pwd)" && cat > .tmp_register.py << 'PY'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import hopsworks

feats = ['f1','f2','f3','f4']
tr = pd.read_csv('data/features_train.csv')
sv = pd.read_csv('data/features_serve.csv')

mean = tr[feats].mean()
std = tr[feats].std(ddof=0)  # population std over TRAIN rows only

def standardize(df, split):
    out = df.copy()
    for f in feats:
        out[f] = ((out[f] - mean[f]) / std[f]).round(6)
    out['split'] = split
    return out[['row_id','split'] + feats]

train_std = standardize(tr, 'train')
serve_std = standardize(sv, 'serve')
both = pd.concat([train_std, serve_std], ignore_index=True)
print('total rows', len(both))
print(both.head(3).to_string())
print(both.tail(3).to_string())

proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='scaled1f3dc5',
    version=1,
    description='Standardized features (train-only mean/population-std), both splits',
    primary_key=['row_id'],
    online_enabled=True,
    statistics_config=False,
)
fg.insert(both)
print('INSERT DONE; fg id', fg.id, 'online_enabled', fg.online_enabled)

tool_input.content:
import pandas as pd
import hopsworks

feats = ['f1', 'f2', 'f3', 'f4']
tr = pd.read_csv('data/features_train.csv')
sv = pd.read_csv('data/features_serve.csv')

# mean and population std (no Bessel correction) over TRAIN rows ONLY
mean = tr[feats].mean()
std = tr[feats].std(ddof=0)


def standardize(df, split):
    out = df.copy()
    for f in feats:
        out[f] = ((out[f] - mean[f]) / std[f]).round(6)
    out['split'] = split
    return out[['row_id', 'split'] + feats]


both = pd.concat([standardize(tr, 'train'), standardize(sv, 'serve')], ignore_index=True)
print('total rows', len(both))
print(both.head(3).to_string())
print(both.tail(3).to_string())

proj = hopsworks.login()
fs = proj.get_feature_store()

fg = fs.create_feature_group(
    name='scaled1f3dc5',
    version=1,
    description='Standardized features (train-only mean/population-std), both splits',
    primary_key=['row_id'],
    online_enabled=True,
    statistics_config=False,
)
fg.insert(both)
print('INSERT DONE; fg id', fg.id, 'online_enabled', fg.online_enabled)

import pandas as pd
import hopsworks
feats=['f1','f2','f3','f4']
tr=pd.read_csv('data/features_train.csv'); sv=pd.read_csv('data/features_serve.csv')
mean=tr[feats].mean(); std=tr[feats].std(ddof=0)
def st(df,split):
    o=df.copy()
    for f in feats: o[f]=((o[f]-mean[f])/std[f]).round(6)
    o['split']=split
    return o[['row_id','split']+feats]
both=pd.concat([st(tr,'train'),st(sv,'serve')],ignore_index=True)
print('total rows',len(both)); print(both.head(2).to_string()); print(both.tail(2).to_string())
proj=hopsworks.login(); fs=proj.get_feature_store()
fg=fs.create_feature_group(name='scaled1f3dc5',version=1,
    description='Standardized features (train-only mean/population-std), both splits',
    primary_key=['row_id'],online_enabled=True,statistics_config=False)
fg.insert(both)
print('INSERT DONE; fg id',fg.id,'online_enabled',fg.online_enabled)
